subject: maths
question: A train covers a distance of 72 km in 40 minutes. Travelling at the same speed, how many metres will the train cover in 6 seconds?
solution:
**Given:**

A train covers a distance of 72 km in 40 minutes.

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Distance covered in given time = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Speed = 72 km / 40 min

⇒ Speed = 72000 m / (40 × 60) s

⇒ Speed = 72000 m / 2400 s

⇒ Speed = 30 m/s

Distance covered in 6 seconds = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 30 m/s × 6 s

⇒ Distance = 180 m

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
